metadata.title: (In)stability results for the Light Ray Transform
metadata.abstract: We prove quantitative instability results for the light ray transform in the Minkowski setting, and locally in the smooth and Gevrey categories. In the smooth Sobolev setting, we show that no modulus of continuity can be better than $t^\alpha$ for any $\alpha \in(0,1)$, while in the Gevrey setting we obtain an explicit logarithmic lower bound. On the other hand, using the relation between stationary geometries and magnetic(-potential) systems, we obtain a stability result for "time moments" of the light ray transform.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 研究光线积分变换的局部稳定性障碍，并把平稳几何中的问题联系到磁系统。
techniques: Smooth/Gevrey 正则性下的局部分析
analysis.breakthrough: 区分不同正则性下的 Hölder 或对数稳定性限制，并给出结构化的正向稳定性结果。
analysis.limitations: 局部不稳定性与额外结构下的稳定性不是互相矛盾的全局结论；未解决一般逆问题。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。未见 AI 协作声明仅指这些已检查来源，不代表已核验整篇论文完全由人类完成。
analysis.priorityReason: 对 Lorentz 几何逆问题有方法价值，和曲率极限研究较间接。
